_comment: Order board (#44, professions.md section 2). Customers who post orders in each player's Workshop. 'kinds' says which order types a customer posts: standard (your own goods), bundle (your goods plus another guild's; from 'bundle_min_crafts' crafts made, a stand-in for Journeyman until skill ranks arrive), collector (one item at a high price). Lines use {items} for what's asked. Rewards are priced from each item's usual value; reward_multiplier is the WHOLE reward (gold + any rare material at its usual value) and must stay below market.ceiling_multiplier, so orders can't be filled at a profit from the Guild Suppliers (validator rule). Collectors get a guaranteed rare material instead of a big gold multiple (until quality tiers let them ask for Masterwork goods suppliers don't sell). Every number is [tune].

customers.line: Needs {items} before tonight's ball at the palazzo. Discretion appreciated.
